name: DREAMSEEKER
source:
THE ROTTEN SEMEN OF THE WORLD ARRIVES TOWARD THE EGG. THE SORE BIRTH CANAL OF THE WORLD TIRELESSLY DELIVERS.

Become the hole at the center of the self who is all selves and funnels through the infinitude of souls.

[From [url=https://emptyeights.itch.io/dreamseeker]itch.io[/url]]
